verses.1: It was in the hand of the LORD; the LORD brought me out by His spirit. He placed me in a valley, and it was filled with water.
verses.2: And he carried me around them, all around. And there were countless people on the shores of the bay. And there were also countless boats there.
verses.3: And he said to Adam, “Let these shadows come to life.” And he said, “O Lord Jehovah, you know everything.”
verses.4: And he said to me, “These are the gates of heaven. You said to them, ‘The gates of heaven have heard the words of Jehovah.’”
verses.5: So said Adonai Jehovah to these people: “Now, I will bring upon you the spirit of life and your survival.”
verses.6: And I will give you gifts. I will cover you with feathers and make you covered with skin. I will also give you breath and life. And you shall know that I am Jehovah.
verses.7: And I was brought up, as it was commanded. There was a sound like that of being brought up. And then, the objects rushed towards each other.
verses.8: And I saw that on them there were feathers and feathers that grew from their bodies. There was also a cloud above them, but there was no spirit in them.
verses.9: And he said to me, “Be raised up into the air. Be raised up from among men.” And he said to the air, “Thus says Adonai YHWH: From among the four winds, let there be a wind that will carry these people away. And they shall live.”
verses.10: And I was carried away, as if I were being chased. Then the wind rushed into them. They stood on their feet, surrounded by a great crowd of people.
verses.11: And Adam said to his son, “All the houses of Israel have these idols in them. They worship their own idols, and as a result, their laws are destroyed. They have been punished for their actions.”
verses.12: Therefore, I have come and said to them, “O Lord Jehovah, see, I open your graves, and I bring you out from your graves among my people. I will bring you into the land of Israel.”
verses.13: And know that I, Jehovah, am who opens your graves and brings you out of your graves with My power.
verses.14: And I will give you my spirit, and you shall live. I will place you on your land, and you shall know that I am the LORD who spoke and did these things. Amen, LORD!
verses.15: And the word of Jehovah came to me, saying:
verses.16: And you, son of Adam, take one tree and write on it “To Judah and to the descendants of Israel, my friends.” Then take another tree and write on it “To Joseph and to all the houses of Israel, my friends.”
verses.17: And bring them together, one by one, for you to plant them in one tree. Then they will become one with each other in your hands.
verses.18: And when your people say to you, “Do not tell us what these things are.”
verses.19: I said to them, “Thus says the Lord God: I will take the tree of Jesse from his place. I will also take the branches of Israel’s kingdom and make them one tree. They will become one in my hands.”
verses.20: And let the trees be those on which it is written to be written in your hand, for their eyes.
verses.21: And I said to them, “O Lord Jehovah, behold, I am going to take the children of Israel from among the nations where they have gone. I will gather them together and bring them into their land.”
verses.22: And I will make them one nation on this land, in the mountains of Israel. There will be one king for all of them. There will no longer be two nations, nor will they be divided into two kings anymore.
verses.23: And they shall not be covered with their sins anymore, nor with all their transgressions. I have forgiven them from all their sins they committed. They became my people, and I will be their God.
verses.24: And my servant David will be their king. He will be one person for all of them. They will follow his laws and keep his commandments.
verses.25: And they shall dwell on the earth that I have given to my servant Jacob. Your ancestors also shall dwell there. They and their descendants, and the children of their children, will dwell there forever. And David, my servant, will reign over them forever.
verses.26: And I made a covenant of peace with them. It will be an eternal covenant for them. I will increase their numbers, and I will place my holy things in their possession forever.
verses.27: And I will be their dwelling place. I will be their God, and they will be my people.
verses.28: And the nations shall know that I, the LORD, have sanctified Israel, so that they may be my holy people forever.
